players.product: FC-BGA and BT package substrates (Guangzhou plant) for processor, memory and PMIC chips

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 total operating revenue was RMB 152.96 hundred million, up 46.33% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 22.51 hundred million, up 65.55%, on AI compute infrastructure investment: wired communication and data center revenue grew clearly, package substrate orders rose on computing and storage demand, and the Guangzhou plant ramp went smoothly.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 152.96 hundred million (+46.33% YoY); net profit attributable RMB 22.51 hundred million (+65.55%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): package substrate revenue in H1 2026 was RMB 36.67 hundred million, up 110.76%, 23.97% of total revenue, with gross margin 31.35%, up 16.20 percentage points; the share of storage substrates rose, demand for processor-chip substrates grew fast and PMIC orders were released.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 36.67 hundred million (+110.76%); 23.97% of revenue; GM 31.35% (+16.20 pts)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): at the Guangzhou package substrate project, BT substrate capacity ramp is progressing steadily and high-end FC-BGA substrate products have reached scaled mass production at several customers, accelerating the plant's ramp.

Management (IR record): main raw materials include copper-clad laminate, prepreg, copper foil, gold salt and ink; in H1 2026 gold, copper and tin prices swung sharply and the shortage of key upstream materials such as CCL glass-fibre cloth and copper foil kept worsening, raising costs sharply and weighing on profitability.

Management (IR record): H1 2026 capex focused on PCB and package substrates - the Wuxi AI compute electronic circuit product project, the Guangzhou package substrate plant, and remaining payments for Nantong phase 4 and the Thailand plant - plus technical upgrades to clear bottlenecks.

players.product: High-layer PCBs for AI servers, switches and optical modules; FC-BGA package substrates

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): PCB revenue in H1 2026 was RMB 85.52 hundred million, up 36.32%, 55.91% of total revenue, with gross margin 36.85%, up 2.43 percentage points, as orders for optical modules, switches, AI servers and related products rose sharply.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 85.52 hundred million (+36.32%); 55.91% of revenue; GM 36.85% (+2.43 pts)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): PCB bases are in Shenzhen, Wuxi, Nantong and Thailand; the Thailand plant and Nantong phase 4 started production in H2 2025 and are ramping, and the Wuxi AI compute electronic circuit product project is under construction with a one-year build period.

Shennan Circuits.why: PCB and package substrate maker whose PCB orders for AI servers, switches and optical modules and whose FC-BGA substrate volumes grow with AI compute builds.
Shennan Circuits.evidence: Shennan Circuits IR activity record: 2026-19 (09-03-2026): package substrate revenue RMB 36.67 hundred million (+110.76%); FC-BGA high-end products in scaled mass production at several customers; PCB orders for optical modules, switches and AI servers up sharply.
